This analysis measures item-grain revenue (`SUM(sale_price)`) and volume (`COUNT(*)`) for items with a 'Complete' status [q1]. The scope is restricted to executor-authorized products. No date filter was applied in q1; historical coverage was not audited.

### Limitations
* This query did not measure distinct order counts or distinct customer volume.
* Temporal trends and seasonality were not evaluated.

### Action items (proposed)
* Query distinct `order_key` counts by brand to determine if the item volume is driven by single large orders or multiple separate transactions.
* Group the complete-item revenue by `created_at` month to assess temporal trends.
